Repeat scan witness: same receiver-native physical frequency mapping at signed df exactly and measured halo on independent other ON/OFF scan pair, no interpolation, no artificial repeat injection in primary feature. No truth or labels as inputs; absence of recurrence is not proof of artifact, scans are separate but same cadence, injected positives absent in untouched repeat context so report this limitation. Hold out an additional stationary repeated-injection stress: replay declared original stationary injection at same native frequency in other ON/OFF contexts (measured background, same amplitude scaled to repeat patch); features recomputed without label access; evaluate paired loss separately, no fitting on stress. Keep original parent path and Joint Min rescue.
